findings.finding: The corridor limits amendment and non-derogability limits emergency, and every corridor member is non-derogable while the converse does not hold. Nothing checks the converse.
Every three-place record completion carries a distinctness constraint and an independent review authority; the challenge-reader skeleton is a later convention two families predate.
Every family with a challenge reader carries an independent alternate, so declining to read confers no veto.
No rule proves a reader received anything, acted, or completed a remedy. Every duty is a leaf.
Accessible format and language on request, proactive design, adjustment without a fee, and no meaning carried only by one sense — as conditions on a supplied record.
Script 15 checks artifact properties only. Human screen-reader validation was withdrawn and no accessibility-for-users claim follows.
Care derives from a matching receipt and an authorised independent witness, never from a provider's own word.
No aggregate health measure exists and none may become an individual label.
The family, dependency, reproduction and care baseline landed 106 person-held barriers and no ordinary-operation interface, so the domain appears only under strain.
`cares` is the posture of one passage in the whole book.
Recognition is arity one, minted by three doors, read by nothing and never joined with itself.
Contribution, wealth and expected productivity are refused as scarcity priority keys, each by name.
Accessible notice, interpretation, assistance, hearing, reasons, challenge and remedy are conditions on a supplied record; money and status cannot be the price of entry.
No finding proves a hearing occurred or that compensation arrived.
Each coercive instrument carries a refusal pin against every floor predicate; the firewall reaches the confinement conclusion only.
The design has no rule reading a building back into a condition, service or remedy, so a facility name is never evidence of compliance.
A concentration finding is structural and actor-side; it adjudicates no truth, no editorial choice, and classifies no audience.
Knowledge and culture is carried by a stated boundary and no passage in which anything goes wrong.
Membership findings produce no standing, punishment, political weight or personal score, and free exit survives.
Foreign recognition, cooperation and readmission are named external assumptions.
Force abroad needs prior authorisation naming objective, basis, scope, geography, means and reporting, and an immediate response ends absent ratification.
Defence is carried by a stated boundary and no passage in which anything goes wrong.
Budget choice, price exclusion, delay, withholding, monopoly, provider failure and refusal to procure are failures and not shortages, each named.
Nothing counts stock, forecasts supply or proves procurement.
Commons axes are non-substitutable: no sustainability score can hide one failed condition.
Ecology is carried by stated boundaries and no passage in which anything goes wrong.
Automated output is support: explanation, contest before effect, and human and independent review by somebody who is not the holder. A sole automated consequential decision is refused.
No rule reads a computed value, and the temporary-assessment exclusion keeps risk, threat, loyalty and dangerousness products out of the consequential record.
No enacted line carries a numeric literal and no relation aggregates, scores or ranks.
The counted-claims rule is guarded on its digit half only; the spelled-out half is prose review, measured at 60 legitimate uses.
